optionalCombinedArm: Only pre-adjudicated required fields added sequentially one key per step; never discover-and-inherit arbitrary runner fields
stageAdmission: Only previous smoke success admits next stage; not-reached explicitly reported
downstreamAdmission: Only P2 success admits parent hooks and confirmation/binding/healthy aggregate analog; no stale negative assertion claimed before execute
cleanup: Only active directly-owned handle or independently verified identity/tree; unknown PID recorded not signalled; bounded cleanup; incomplete remains explicit
output: Allowlisted stage/timing/errno/PID/ownership/canary/hash metadata JSON and JSONL only; no environment values, raw input, profile, credentials or arbitrary PowerShell stderr
